scope: seeded Gazebo simulation only; does not qualify physical hardware

reference.reference_source: analytic plane from tools/generate_p6_known_plane.py plus seed-42 geometry from tools/generate_lunar_terrain.py and exact SDF meshes

rationale.projection: Horizontal p95 is limited to two 0.1 m map cells; vertical p95 is limited to one cell. Absolute bounds reject tails while p95 tolerates isolated depth outliers. The 0.5-1.5 m band is excluded because live depth captures from the fixed mast have no valid ground returns in that range; 1.5-3 m and 3-5 m retain near/far coverage.
rationale.reference_scene: Three clean simulator restarts use an isolated 40 m known plane for projection in both bands and flat-layer false-positive checks; a fourth seeded-world capture evaluates bowl geometry independently.
rationale.slope: Five degrees corresponds to 20 points on the configured 0-25 degree risk scale; the 25 degree plane fixture is the limit case. The live estimator fits a local plane over 1 m to reduce depth-noise amplification.
rationale.bowl: A 0.2 m depression is above the 0.04 m onset and maps to about 76 risk points under the configured 0.25 m full-risk depth; the gate retains margin for rasterization. The terrain layer samples a sparse 3 m outer rim so broad flat crater floors retain center risk.
